definitions.explanation: A situation where the Japanese yen decreases in value relative to other currencies.

examples.japanese: {円安|えんやす}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{輸出|ゆしゅつ}→輸出：02094_yushutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Exports increased due to the weak yen.

examples.japanese: {円安|えんやす}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{輸入|ゆにゅう}→輸入：01742_yunyuu⟧⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Imported goods became more expensive due to the weak yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴史的|れきしてき}→歴史的：05671_rekishiteki⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧{円安|えんやす}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
{円安|えんやす}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{外国人|がいこくじん}→外国人：02869_gaikokujin⟧⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to the weak yen, the number of foreign tourists is increasing.

examples.japanese: {円安|えんやす}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦なるので→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{国内|こくない}→国内：02998_kokunai⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多く：18752_ooku⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: As the yen weakened, travel abroad became more expensive, so more people chose domestic trips.

notes:
{円安|えんやす} means a weak yen (yen depreciation), when the yen's value decreases against other currencies.

FORMS:
⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧ (yen) + ⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧ (cheap/low) → {円安|えんやす}

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {円安|えんやす}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: yen weakens further
- {円安|えんやす}⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧: trend toward yen weakness
- ⟦{歴史的|れきしてき}→歴史的：05671_rekishiteki⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧{円安|えんやす}: historic weak yen
- {円安|えんやす}⟦ドル→ドル：01554_doru⟧⟦{高|だか}→高い：00500_takai⟧: weak yen/strong dollar

ECONOMIC EFFECTS:
- Benefits: Exporters (⟦{輸出|ゆしゅつ}→輸出：02094_yushutsu⟧) profit as Japanese goods become cheaper abroad
- Drawbacks: Imports (⟦{輸入|ゆにゅう}→輸入：01742_yunyuu⟧) cost more, affecting consumers

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{円高|えんだか}→円高：04852_endaka⟧: strong yen (yen appreciation)
